items.title: Remanso (BA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #001
items.en_title: Remanso (BA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #001
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Remanso (BA) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 60,000; proposals close Nov 26, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
